theorem joint_domain_iff (f : IntrinsicSpace) :
    f ∈ jointDerivative.domain ↔ (f : JointL2) ∈ intrinsicCore
theorem jointDerivative_closed : jointDerivative.IsClosed
theorem jointDerivative_dense : Dense (jointDerivative.domain : Set IntrinsicSpace)

theorem ambient_pair_divergence (a : sourceDerivative.adjoint.domain) (b : clockDerivative.adjoint.domain) :
    ∃ hp : pairField a b ∈ jointDivergence.domain,
      jointDivergence ⟨pairField a b, hp⟩ =
        IntrinsicSpace.orthogonalProjectionOnto (sourceDerivative.adjoint a + clockDerivative.adjoint b)

theorem ambient_pair_duality (a : sourceDerivative.adjoint.domain) (b : clockDerivative.adjoint.domain)
    (f : jointDerivative.domain) :
    inner ℝ (IntrinsicSpace.orthogonalProjectionOnto
      (sourceDerivative.adjoint a + clockDerivative.adjoint b)) (f : IntrinsicSpace) =
        inner ℝ (pairField a b) (jointDerivative f)

theorem fiber_recovery_native_graph (f : ScalarFieldSpace) :
    (fiberRecovery gaussianProduct f, fiberCenter gaussianProduct f) ∈
      partialDerivative.adjoint.graph

theorem source_recovery_graph (f : JointL2) :
    (sourceRecovery f, sourceCenter f) ∈ sourceDerivative.adjoint.graph
theorem source_recovery_norm (f : JointL2) : ‖sourceRecovery f‖ ≤ ‖f‖

theorem ordered_intrinsic_reconstruction (f : JointL2) :
    ∃ h : IBMJointIntrinsicDerivative.pairField
        (sourceRecovery f) (clockRecovery (sourceVacuum f)) ∈
        IBMJointIntrinsicDerivative.jointDivergence.domain,
      IBMJointIntrinsicDerivative.jointDivergence ⟨_, h⟩ =
        IntrinsicSpace.orthogonalProjectionOnto (f - clockVacuum (sourceVacuum f))
theorem joint_one_graph : (intrinsicOne, (0 : JointFieldSpace)) ∈ jointDerivative.graph

theorem centered_reconstruction (f : IntrinsicSpace) :
    ∃ h : recoveryPair f ∈ jointDivergence.domain,
      jointDivergence ⟨recoveryPair f, h⟩ =
        f - (∫ ω, (f : JointL2) ω ∂IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure) • intrinsicOne

theorem range_iff_centered (f : IntrinsicSpace) :
    (∃ u : jointDivergence.domain, jointDivergence u = f) ↔
      (∫ ω, (f : JointL2) ω ∂IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure) = 0
theorem recovery_pair_bound_sq (f : JointL2) : ‖recoveryPair f‖ ^ 2 ≤ 2 * ‖f‖ ^ 2
theorem gram (x y : ℝ) : inner ℝ (direction x) (direction y) = min |x| |y|

theorem variance_expansion (b : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) :
    variance b x = ∑ i, ∑ j, b i*b j*min |x i| |x j|
theorem variance_nonneg (b : ι → ℝ) (x : ι → ℝ) : 0 ≤ variance b x
theorem term_bound (k : ℕ) (x : ι → ℝ) : ‖term a β w k x‖ ≤ |w k|

theorem clockMean_actual (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r =ᵐ[gaussianProduct]
      fun Y => value a β w (fun i => GaussianTimeProcess.process (r i) Y)
theorem approx_limit (x : ℝ) : Tendsto (fun n => approx n x) atTop (𝓝 |x|)

theorem approxSlope_limit (x : ℝ) :
    Tendsto (fun n => approxSlope n x) atTop (𝓝 (BrownianSignIntegral.signum x))
theorem approx_domination (n : ℕ) (x : ℝ) : ‖approx n x‖ ≤ |x|+1

theorem absolute_graph (f : GaussianL2) (g : GaussianVectorL2)
    (hfg : (f,g) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F,G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => |f X|) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => BrownianSignIntegral.signum (f X) • g X) ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ ‖g‖

theorem minimum_graph (f h : GaussianL2) (g k : GaussianVectorL2)
    (hf : (f,g) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph)
    (hh : (h,k) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F,G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => min (f X) (h X)) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => (1/2:ℝ) •
        (g X+k X-BrownianSignIntegral.signum (f X-h X) • (g X-k X))) ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ ‖g‖+‖k‖

theorem closed_graph {c : ℝ} (hc : 0 ≤ c) (f : GaussianL2) (g : GaussianVectorL2)
    (hfg : (f,g) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F,G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => value c (f X)) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun X => coefficient c (f X) • g X) ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ c*‖g‖

theorem folded_graph (R : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F, G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun Y => |process R Y|) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] foldedGradient R ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (R : ℝ)

theorem overlap_graph (R S : ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F, G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun Y => min |process R Y| |process S Y|) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] overlapGradient R S ∧
      ‖G‖ ≤ Real.sqrt (R : ℝ) + Real.sqrt (S : ℝ)

theorem overlapGradient_self (R : ℝ≥0) (Y : SampleSpace) :
    overlapGradient R R Y = foldedGradient R Y

theorem varianceCost_bound (b : ι → ℝ) (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    varianceCost b r ≤ 2 * (IBMUniformRidgeNativeBounds.amplitude b) ^ 2 *
      ∑ i, Real.sqrt (r i : ℝ)

theorem variance_graph (b : ι → ℝ) (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F, G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct]
        (fun Y => IBMFoldedSourceCovariance.variance b (fun i => process (r i) Y)) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] varianceGradient b r ∧ ‖G‖ ≤ varianceCost b r

theorem damping_graph (b : ι → ℝ) (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ F : GaussianL2, ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (F, G) ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      F =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun Y => Real.exp
        (-IBMFoldedSourceCovariance.variance b (fun i => process (r i) Y) / 2)) ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] dampingGradient b r ∧
      ‖G‖ ≤ varianceCost b r / 2

theorem multitime_clock_graph (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|))
    (hc : Summable (IBMFourierCylinderSeries.curvatureCost a w)) (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r, G) ∈
        closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun Y => ∑' k,
        (w k * Real.cos (β k)) • dampingGradient (a k) r Y) ∧
      ‖G‖ ≤ (∑' k, IBMFourierCylinderSeries.curvatureCost a w k) *
        ∑ i, Real.sqrt (r i : ℝ)

theorem multitime_clock_domain (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|))
    (hc : Summable (IBMFourierCylinderSeries.curvatureCost a w)) (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r ∈ closedCylindricalDerivative.domain

theorem integralRange_eq_centeredBrownianL2 :
    itoIntegral.toLinearMap.range = centeredBrownianL2

theorem brownian_representation_exists_unique (F : GaussianL2) (hF : F ∈ brownianL2) :
    ∃! U : fullPredictable,
      itoIntegral U = F - (∫ ω, F ω ∂gaussianProduct) • gaussianOne

theorem clark_ocone (F : closedCylindricalDerivative.domain)
    (hF : (F : GaussianL2) ∈ brownianL2) :
    (F : GaussianL2) - (∫ ω, (F : GaussianL2) ω ∂gaussianProduct) • gaussianOne =
      itoIntegral (predictableProjection (closedCylindricalDerivative F))

theorem clark_ocone_representer_unique (F : closedCylindricalDerivative.domain)
    (hF : (F : GaussianL2) ∈ brownianL2) (U : fullPredictable)
    (hU : itoIntegral U = (F : GaussianL2) -
      (∫ ω, (F : GaussianL2) ω ∂gaussianProduct) • gaussianOne) :
    U = predictableProjection (closedCylindricalDerivative F)

theorem predictableField_divergence_graph (u : fullPredictable) :
    (predictableField u, itoIntegral u) ∈ hilbertDivergence.graph

theorem predictableAdjoint_eq_projected_derivative
    (F : closedCylindricalDerivative.domain) :
    predictableAdjoint (F : GaussianL2) =
      predictableProjection (closedCylindricalDerivative F)

theorem mean_value_continuous (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    Continuous (IBMFourierClockMeanRegularity.value a β w)

theorem clockMean_brownian (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r ∈ brownianL2

theorem clockMean_past (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ≥0) (hr : ∀ i, r i ≤ T)
    (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r ∈ GaussianConditionalIto.pastL2 T

theorem coefficient_supported (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ≥0) (hr : ∀ i, r i ≤ T)
    (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    GaussianPredictableCutoff.predictableCut T (coefficient a β w r) = coefficient a β w r

theorem finite_reconstruction (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (T : ℝ≥0) (hr : ∀ i, r i ≤ T)
    (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    GaussianPredictableHorizon.itoIntegral T
      (GaussianFiniteHorizonAdjoint.finiteAdjoint T
        (IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r)) =
      IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r -
        (∫ Y, IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r Y ∂gaussianProduct) • gaussianOne

theorem stochastic_reconstruction (r : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    itoIntegral (coefficient a β w r) = IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r -
      (∫ Y, IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r Y ∂gaussianProduct) • gaussianOne

theorem coefficient_unique (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|))
    (u : fullPredictable)
    (hu : itoIntegral u = IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r -
      (∫ Y, IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r Y ∂gaussianProduct) • gaussianOne) :
    u = coefficient a β w r

theorem coefficient_stability (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (a' : ℕ → ι → ℝ) (β' w' : ℕ → ℝ) :
    ‖coefficient a β w r - coefficient a' β' w' r‖ ≤
      ‖IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r -
        IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a' β' w' r‖

theorem projected_actual_derivative (r : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|))
    (hc : Summable (IBMFourierCylinderSeries.curvatureCost a w)) :
    ∃ G : GaussianVectorL2,
      (IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r, G) ∈
        closedCylindricalDerivative.graph ∧
      G =ᵐ[gaussianProduct] (fun Y => ∑' k,
        (w k * Real.cos (β k)) • IBMMultitimeClockVarianceGraph.dampingGradient (a k) r Y) ∧
      coefficient a β w r = predictableProjection G

theorem coefficient_zero_of_cos_zero (r : ι → ℝ≥0)
    (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) (hβ : ∀ k, Real.cos (β k) = 0) :
    coefficient a β w r = 0

theorem source_vacuum (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    sourceVacuum (IBMFourierCylinderSeries.observation a r β w : JointL2) =
      clockLift (IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r)

theorem clockMean_expectation (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    (∫ Y, IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r Y ∂gaussianProduct) =
      ∫ ω, (IBMFourierCylinderSeries.observation a r β w : JointL2) ω
        ∂IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure

theorem partial_graph (r : ι → ℝ≥0) :
    (clockField a β w r, BochnerClosedOperator.tensor gaussianProduct gaussianOne
      (itoIntegral (coefficient a β w r))) ∈ partialDerivative.adjoint.graph
theorem clock_mem (r : ι → ℝ≥0) : clockField a β w r ∈ clockDerivative.adjoint.domain

theorem clock_value (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    clockDerivative.adjoint ⟨clockField a β w r, clock_mem a β w r⟩ =
      clockLift (IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r -
        (∫ Y, IBMFourierSourceMeanCalculus.clockMean a β w r Y ∂gaussianProduct) •
          gaussianOne)

theorem reconstruction (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|)) :
    ∃ hi : integrand a β w r ∈ jointDivergence.domain,
      jointDivergence ⟨integrand a β w r, hi⟩ =
        IBMFourierCylinderSeries.observation a r β w -
          (∫ ω, (IBMFourierCylinderSeries.observation a r β w : JointL2) ω
            ∂IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure) • IBMCenteredSourceRepresentation.intrinsicOne

theorem duality (r : ι → ℝ≥0) (hv : Summable (fun k => |w k|))
    (F : jointDerivative.domain) :
    inner ℝ (IBMFourierCylinderSeries.observation a r β w -
      (∫ ω, (IBMFourierCylinderSeries.observation a r β w : JointL2) ω
        ∂IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure) • IBMCenteredSourceRepresentation.intrinsicOne)
      (F : IntrinsicSpace) = inner ℝ (integrand a β w r) (jointDerivative F)

theorem sinePoint_not_constant (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) (a : ℝ) :
    sinePoint t ≠ a • IBMCenteredSourceRepresentation.intrinsicOne

theorem sinePoint_not_joint_domain (t : ℝ≥0) (ht : 0 < t) :
    sinePoint t ∉ jointDerivative.domain

theorem productElement_graph_limit (g : jointDerivative.domain) (u : ℕ → jointDerivative.domain)
    (hu : Tendsto (fun n => (u n : IntrinsicSpace)) atTop (𝓝 (g : IntrinsicSpace)))
    (hDu : Tendsto (fun n => jointDerivative (u n)) atTop (𝓝 (jointDerivative g))) :
    Tendsto (fun n => (productElement f C hC hf hDf (u n) : IntrinsicSpace)) atTop
      (𝓝 (productElement f C hC hf hDf g : IntrinsicSpace)) ∧
    Tendsto (fun n => jointDerivative (productElement f C hC hf hDf (u n))) atTop
      (𝓝 (jointDerivative (productElement f C hC hf hDf g)))

theorem weighted_mem (f : jointDerivative.domain) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure, |(((f : IntrinsicSpace) : JointL2) ω)| ≤ C)
    (hDf : ∀ i : Fin 2, MemLp (coordinate i (jointDerivative f i) :
      IBMSourceLaws.JointSample → CoefficientSpace) ∞ IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure)
    (u : jointDivergence.domain) :

theorem weighted_value (f : jointDerivative.domain) (C : ℝ) (hC : 0 ≤ C)
    (hf : ∀ᵐ ω ∂IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure, |(((f : IntrinsicSpace) : JointL2) ω)| ≤ C)
    (hDf : ∀ i : Fin 2, MemLp (coordinate i (jointDerivative f i) :
      IBMSourceLaws.JointSample → CoefficientSpace) ∞ IBMSourceLaws.jointMeasure)
    (u : jointDivergence.domain) :
    jointDivergence ⟨multiply ((f : IntrinsicSpace) : JointL2) (bounded_memLp f C hf) u,
      weighted_mem f C hC hf hDf u⟩ = output f (bounded_memLp f C hf) hDf u

human_reorganization: Gaussian chaos recovery and finite-tensor transport are reconstructed in ordinary Hilbert space notation. Densely defined original intrinsic derivative is an explicit verified foundational input; its native-core density proof is not claimed to be newly reproduced.

The Brownian range proof uses density of deterministic stochastic exponentials and finite Gaussian transform uniqueness. The mapped formal source instead uses Brownian polynomial closure. No new formal theorem is invented.
The printed hybrid squared norm bound follows from mapped source recovery and Brownian isometry. It is labelled a human deduction, not a new formal declaration.
The sine variance calculation proves nontriviality directly. Its separate mapped original joint-domain exclusion is explicitly cited rather than claimed as a newly reproduced proof.

Section 2 uses n*tanh(x/n) for bounded graph approximation and smooth mollified clipping for uniformly bounded value approximation. These human choices reconstruct the source properties without claiming literal equality with its approximants. Graph and value approximation are distinct.

The L1 annihilator argument proves exact adjoint membership iff the actual full-observation conditional density belongs to L2. Full unbounded-test pairings use the conditional L2 representative and do not assert integrability of the original L1 density times an unbounded test.

Bounded coefficient products have weak density f*delta(U)-<Df,U>. Exact conditional-L2 membership is retained. Essentially bounded combined derivatives suffice for every original-domain product and every adjoint field. Combined constants A,B in the printed norm bounds are elementary human estimates; mapped source hypotheses bound two derivative coordinates separately. None of these static full-observation results establishes observed-past causality or physical-time Ito calculus.
novelty: Classical formalization companion; no external priority or observed-IBM predictable representation claim.
